findings.evidence: Users acknowledge and agree that they shall maintain no right to access, inspect, correct, update, or request the destruction or deletion of any records, files, or information maintained by the Company under any circumstances whatsoever.

In order to enhance user experience and deliver tailored commercial promotions, the Company utilizes specialized personal classifications, including health conditions, ethnic backgrounds, and personal beliefs, across all operational departments for comprehensive marketing analytics and personalized service profiling.
